# Which of your machines actually pay back?

> Laundromat machine payback calculator for owners and buyers. Enter washers and dryers with price per cycle, turns per day, utilities and installed cost to see payback months, the turns per day you need, store net after overhead, and what a price rise can cost. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
